newsitem.title: USA: PECO 1,055 MW Pa. nuke seen up on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: PECO 1,055 MW Pa. nuke seen up on Saturday.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's 1,055 megawatt (MW) Limerick nuclear power unit 2 should resume electricity production on Saturday following a repair outage, a company spokesman said Friday.
"We expect it to reconnect to the grid tomorrow morning," spokesman Michael Wood said.
The unit, in Pottstown, Pa., was shut Dec 6 after operators detected an oil leak in the turbine's hydraulic control system.
The adjacent 1,055 MW Limerick unit 1 continued to operate normally at full power.
